# Playbook: Retire Replaced Tickets

Read: [`story.md`](story.md), [`jira-conventions.md`](jira-conventions.md)

Use when a ticket is replaced by a split, a decomposition or a consolidation.

## Steps

1. Resolve it as **Won't Do**.
2. Add an **"is replaced by"** link to the replacement.
3. Strip the Fix Version, sprint and assignee.
4. Remove bracket status markers ([Absorbed…], [Consolidated…], [Duplicate]) from the Summary.
5. Show the list of proposed changes first; write to Jira only after approval (`jira-conventions.md#write-policy`).

## Worked example: [MYM-529](https://mathnasium.atlassian.net/browse/MYM-529)

- Retire Stories [MYM-552](https://mathnasium.atlassian.net/browse/MYM-552) to [MYM-555](https://mathnasium.atlassian.net/browse/MYM-555).
- Retire sub-tasks [MYM-547](https://mathnasium.atlassian.net/browse/MYM-547), [MYM-583](https://mathnasium.atlassian.net/browse/MYM-583) and [MYM-585](https://mathnasium.atlassian.net/browse/MYM-585) to [MYM-589](https://mathnasium.atlassian.net/browse/MYM-589), plus the other "Consolidated into…" items under [MYM-591](https://mathnasium.atlassian.net/browse/MYM-591).
- Archive Epic [MYM-609](https://mathnasium.atlassian.net/browse/MYM-609).
- Rename [MYM-593](https://mathnasium.atlassian.net/browse/MYM-593) to [MYM-597](https://mathnasium.atlassian.net/browse/MYM-597) into the Story format.
- Keep [MYM-551](https://mathnasium.atlassian.net/browse/MYM-551) and [MYM-556](https://mathnasium.atlassian.net/browse/MYM-556) to [MYM-559](https://mathnasium.atlassian.net/browse/MYM-559).
